title: MDR – A wireless signal acquisition device for rapid multimodal cardiac assessment: a multicentric clinical study
summary: The data collected in this pilot study will be used to develop the test product, LynxPatch. LynxPatch contains a series of sensors that enable the automatic recording of a wide range of measurements at the same time. The LynxPatch is easily attached to the chest with four adhesive electrodes, providing a simple, fast and accurate way to support clinical examination of the heart. The aim of this study is to gather evidence of the accuracy of the LynxPatch compared to reference devices in a clinical setting. The user-friendliness, accuracy and feasibility of the LynxPatch sensors will be evaluated. In order to examine LynxPatch in patients with cardiac parameters within and outside the normal range, patients from cardiology (group 1) and surgery (group 2) will be included.
conditions: Factors influencing health status and contact with health services

interventions.name:
Test device: LynxPatch 
Names of reference devices: 
12-channel ECG (ELI280, Mortara Instrument) 
Echocardiogram (standard device at the test site) 
Comparator ICG (CardioScreen 1000) 
Digital stethoscope (Littman CORE digital stethoscope) 
All measurements will be performed during one study v

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Provision of informed consent, i.e. the subject must be able to understand and sign the patient information and consent form.
Group 1: Patients with planned cardiac examination
Group 2: Patients with planned elective surgery
Exclusion criteria:
Subject is pregnant / breastfeeding 
Subject has compromised skin in the location where the LynxPatch is intended to be positioned 
Subject is in critical condition requiring intensive care
